Evidence & scope

Supplier inclusion audited from the pinned provider documents with separate source-verifier and adversarial AI reviews. Offerings, policy descriptions and provider-reported cases remain distinct from independently measured delivery, actual worker outcomes or commercial quality. Review of source statements does not establish ownership or operational certification.
